stage: Additional candidate after the first genuine noise run; original requirements remain unchanged
reason: Baseline variance is about 98.7% flicker; the input pair contributes about 88%, PMOS mirror about 12%. More current alone misses the power limit and does not meet noise. Spend area and increase input gm/I instead.
implementation_note: A 1000 um single device and its nf=10 variant were rejected by the model's total-W bins. The wrapper declares m but does not forward it; an m=10 probe left the operating point unchanged. Use ten explicit parallel 100/1 um units per branch and sum their independent PSD contributions. Each unit retains the teaching junction geometry, so total junction geometry also increases.
limitations: Large area and input loading are costs, not a silicon-verified optimum. Model noise scaling is not a measured-device accuracy guarantee.
